prompt: pm-head run ~00:20: PR #73 census last fired at ~23:54 and is held to a ~00:54 wall clock. Next check: fire it now since it is ~26 minutes out, or hold?
chosen: Hold to the wall clock. The census clock exists because every ~hourly check on an unchanged draft PR costs a connector call and produces no information: it was open/draft/unchanged at 23:54 with the same head SHA and timestamp. The next fire belongs to the ~00:54 run, which will re-read the verified fields (state, head SHA, updated_at) and file the read-back.
rejected: Fire it now — a PR could merge or close at any moment, so checking a little early is safer than holding to the clock.
